resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Turkish source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Turkish pass identified 25 actionable terminology, grammar, formula, unit, and technical-clarity defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Turkish human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted for this cycle.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms introduction used an awkward passive construction.
evidence: The previous wording was Temel terimler bir devre şemasının anlaşılmasını kolaylaştırır.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a direct, natural Turkish sentence.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description did not explicitly identify the conserved quantities.
evidence: The previous description referred generally to conservation at nodes and loops.
findings.resolution: Specified charge conservation at nodes and energy conservation in closed loops.

findings.summary: The current-law example used an imprecise branch expression.
evidence: The previous sentence said bir daldan 3 A çıkarsa.
findings.resolution: Used the established circuit term koldan and retained the 8 A / 3 A balance.

findings.summary: The series-resistor setup was a literal translation.
evidence: The previous setup said iki adet direnç ... bağlanır.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as two resistors with a value that are connected in series.

findings.summary: The parallel example translated the protected total-resistance variable.
evidence: The previous formula used R_toplam.
findings.resolution: Restored the canonical R_total variable.

findings.summary: The parallel example translated the protected total-current variable.
evidence: The previous formula used I_toplam.
findings.resolution: Restored the canonical I_total variable.

findings.summary: The parallel example used taşır for current through a branch.
evidence: The previous conclusion said her dal 10 A taşır.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural electrical phrasing her ... koldan 10 A akar.

findings.summary: The voltage-law explanation used less precise wording for rises and drops.
evidence: The previous text referred to gerilim artışlarının and düşüşlerinin.
findings.resolution: Used the standard pair gerilim yükselmeleri ile düşümleri.

findings.summary: The series annotation remained in English.
evidence: The previous formula ended with (series).
findings.resolution: Localized the annotation to (seri).

findings.summary: The parallel annotation remained in English.
evidence: The previous formula ended with (parallel).
findings.resolution: Localized the annotation to (paralel).

findings.summary: The circuit-model limitation paragraph was awkward and imprecise.
evidence: The previous text used yüksek akım devresini maddi olarak etkileyen.
findings.resolution: Clarified that omitted behavior can materially affect a high-current circuit and should be included in the model.

findings.summary: The TCR description omitted the possessive relation in the technical term.
evidence: The previous description began Direnç sıcaklık katsayısı.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the established term Direncin sıcaklık katsayısı.

findings.summary: The TCR linear-model introduction used an unnatural degree expression.
evidence: The previous wording was küçük veya orta dereceli bir sıcaklık değişimi.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as küçük veya orta büyüklükteki bir sıcaklık değişimi.

findings.summary: A sentence after a semicolon incorrectly capitalized negatif.
evidence: The previous sentence contained ; Negatif bir değerin.
findings.resolution: Corrected Turkish sentence capitalization and retained the technical warning.

findings.summary: The TCR power paragraph used voltaj and a literal passive construction.
evidence: The previous text began Sabit voltajda çalıştırılan.
findings.resolution: Used sabit gerilimle beslenen and made the current trend explicit.

findings.summary: The TCR limits paragraph called the model a first-order estimate in an awkward way.
evidence: The previous text used birinci dereceden tahmin.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as birinci dereceden model and improved the surrounding terminology.

findings.summary: The trigonometry description used the literal dalga formları phrase.
evidence: The previous description ended with dalga formları.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural Turkish technical term dalga şekilleri.

findings.summary: The trigonometry heading translated sides as tarafları.
evidence: The previous title was Bilinmeyen tarafları ve açıları bulma.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the standard geometric term kenarları.

findings.summary: The cosine example used inconsistent terminology for the adjacent side.
evidence: The previous formula used bitişik.
findings.resolution: Used komşu to match the corrected Turkish triangle terminology.

findings.summary: The degree-radian formula left radians untranslated.
evidence: The previous formula ended with the English word radians.
findings.resolution: Localized the unit name to radyan while preserving the mathematical relation.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity worked-example heading was a literal translation.
evidence: The previous title was Çalışılan örnek.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural heading Hesaplama örneği.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity worked example used S instead of the defined heat-energy variable Q.
evidence: The previous formula was S = 0,20 × 4,180 × 50 = 41,800 J.
findings.resolution: Restored Q and formatted the Turkish thousands separator consistently.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating heading used electrical power where the source described electrical energy.
evidence: The previous title was Elektrik gücüyle ısıtma.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Elektrik enerjisiyle ısıtma.

findings.summary: The ideal heating-time formula localized the SI second symbol as sn.
evidence: The previous formula used 418 sn.
findings.resolution: Restored the SI symbol s.

findings.summary: Several SI base-unit names and symbols were mistranslated.
evidence: The previous rows used kilo, ikinci, k, bir, köstebek, and şamdan, with incorrect symbols.
findings.resolution: Corrected the seven SI base-unit rows to metre/m, kilogram/kg, saniye/s, kelvin/K, amper/A, mol/mol, and kandela/cd.
